title.en: An Act Establishing A National High School in Kongkong Valley, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, To Be Known As the Kongkong Valley National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing A National High School in Kongkong Valley, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, To Be Known As the Kongkong Valley National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Kongkong Valley, Thị trấn Kasibu, Tỉnh Nueva Vizcaya được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Kongkong Valley
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติใน Kongkong Valley, เทศบาล Kasibu, จังหวัด Nueva Vizcaya ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Kongkong Valley
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Kongkong Valley, Kotamadya Kasibu, Provinsi Nueva Vizcaya dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Kongkong Valley
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Kongkong Valley, Perbandaran Kasibu, Wilayah Nueva Vizcaya dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Kongkong Valley

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8260_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, a national high school in Kongkong Valley, Municipality of Kasibu, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, to be known as the Kongkong Valley National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
